atoms.exact_source_text: A relevant Supply appears as a small inline synergy on a valid Approach.
atoms.normalized_claim: A relevant Supply appears as a small inline synergy on a valid Approach.

atoms.exact_source_text: The interface states the contextual effect and that the item will be consumed.
atoms.normalized_claim: The interface states the contextual effect and that the item will be consumed.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Supply is committed only when it can credibly affect the chosen Approach or its consequences.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply is committed only when it can credibly affect the chosen Approach or its consequences.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Supply is consumed when committed, whether or not the Approach achieves its intended outcome.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Supply is consumed when committed, whether or not the Approach achieves its intended outcome.

atoms.exact_source_text: Its stated effect still modifies the final resolution.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply's stated effect still modifies the final resolution.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Supply is normally stronger than a reusable Tool
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply is normally stronger than a reusable Tool.

atoms.exact_source_text: it may decisively soften a consequence
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply may decisively soften a consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: preserve an additional stake
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply may preserve an additional stake.

atoms.exact_source_text: extend an achieved result
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply may extend an achieved result.

atoms.exact_source_text: enable a credible alternate resolution
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply may enable a credible alternate resolution.

atoms.exact_source_text: It never replaces the Turn
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply never replaces the Turn.

atoms.exact_source_text: or guarantees success.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Supply never guarantees success.

atoms.exact_source_text: Supply availability follows its carrier.
atoms.normalized_claim: Supply availability follows its carrier.

atoms.exact_source_text: Separation, incapacity, tharn, or inability to bring the item makes it unavailable.
atoms.normalized_claim: Separation, incapacity, tharn, or inability to bring the item makes a Supply unavailable.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Encounter MEET Turn permits one active personal-item intervention
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Encounter MEET Turn permits one active personal-item intervention.

atoms.exact_source_text: select one Tool or spend one Supply
atoms.normalized_claim: The one active intervention consists of selecting one Tool or spending one Supply.

atoms.exact_source_text: Keepsakes do not count as active interventions because they are present rather than used.
atoms.normalized_claim: Keepsakes do not count as active interventions because they are present rather than used.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each Citizen has one Supply box.
atoms.normalized_claim: Each Citizen has one Supply box.

atoms.exact_source_text: Party capacity is simply the number of participating Citizens
atoms.normalized_claim: Party capacity is simply the number of participating Citizens.

atoms.exact_source_text: there is no transferable abstract Supply capacity.
atoms.normalized_claim: There is no transferable abstract Supply capacity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Outside an Encounter, TRAVEL -\> Party View -\> Citizen View allows the player to discard a carried Supply at will.
atoms.normalized_claim: Outside an Encounter, TRAVEL -> Party View -> Citizen View allows the player to discard a carried Supply at will.

atoms.exact_source_text: It leaves play
atoms.normalized_claim: A discarded Supply leaves play.

atoms.exact_source_text: and does not return to the Colony pool.
atoms.normalized_claim: A discarded Supply does not return to the Colony pool.

atoms.exact_source_text: An unspent Supply returns to the Colony prepared-Supply pool at Homecoming
atoms.normalized_claim: An unspent Supply returns to the Colony prepared-Supply pool at Homecoming.

atoms.exact_source_text: and every Citizen's Supply box clears.
atoms.normalized_claim: Every Citizen's Supply box clears at Homecoming.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Keepsake is a persistent emotional anchor with provenance and personal meaning.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake is a persistent emotional anchor with provenance and personal meaning.

atoms.exact_source_text: It belongs to one Citizen's life rather than to a Colony-wide equipment pool.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Keepsake belongs to one Citizen's life rather than to a Colony-wide equipment pool.

atoms.exact_source_text: A current Keepsake remains equipped
atoms.normalized_claim: A current Keepsake remains equipped.

atoms.exact_source_text: and automatically accompanies the Citizen Away.
atoms.normalized_claim: A current Keepsake automatically accompanies the Citizen Away.
